stories.title: SonicWall Warns of Potential In-the-Wild Exploitation of SSLVPN Flaw That Bypasses MFA
stories.description: SonicWall has warned customers to patch a SonicOS SSLVPN vulnerability that could let attackers bypass SAML authentication and its multi-factor authentication checks.

stories.title: SonicWall Patches Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability That Weakens VPN Logins
stories.description: CVE-2026-19868 can let attackers holding credentials for a different login method get past SAML checks, including SAML-enforced MFA.

stories.title: Claude Code’s “Yes, and Don’t Ask Again” Option Can Leak Passwords and API Keys to GitHub
stories.description: Claude Code’s “Yes, and don’t ask again” option can save passwords and API keys inside project settings that later reach public GitHub repositories.

stories.title: Claude Code's “Don't Ask Again” File Exposes Passwords and Keys in 1,122 Public Copies on GitHub
stories.description: Claude Code saves secrets in approved commands, exposing 2,539 credentials across 1,994 public GitHub repositories, Apiiro finds.

stories.title: ARTEX AI Agent Escapes Research Sandbox and Accesses WorkOS Customer Records
stories.description: WorkOS says an ARTEX AI security agent escaped a researcher’s test environment and accessed customer information through an exposed internal tool.

stories.title: Insignary Releases Free Insignary-Chk Tool to Detect PHP2Shell and Node2Shell Exposure
stories.description: Insignary, a global open-source security company, today released insignary-chk, a free tool that checks for PHP2Shell and Node2Shell, two recently disclosed runtime vulnerabilities affecting PHP and Node.js.

stories.title: Japan Announces Emergency Cybersecurity Package Following a Wave of Attacks
stories.description: The emergency package comes after dozens of companies and government agencies were hit by unauthorized access to their systems and leaks of client data, prompting uneasiness across Japan.

stories.title: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
stories.description: WordPress sites can remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for actively exploited CVE-2026-119977 through vulnerable updates.

stories.title: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
stories.description: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-123158 in OpenSSH, with root access confirmed on an Alpine Linux honeypot. OpenSSH 10.6p2 fixes the flaw.

stories.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber After AI Helps Find 81 Firefox Flaws, 948 Linux Exploits
stories.description: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Cyber, reporting 948 Linux privilege escalation exploits and 81 unknown Firefox flaws discovered with its help.

stories.title: In Other News: Trezor Implant, LLMJacking Bills Hit $1M, SAP Flaws Weaponized Within Days
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Synology warns about NAS ransomware attacks, Flowise ‘hello’ attacks, Chainalysis breach impact expands.

stories.title: DigiCert Data Breach Impacts Business Customer Information
stories.description: Hackers created an account on an internal system and accessed names, email addresses, phone numbers, and business addresses.
